load_image_as_rgb_numpy: load an image file and return it as a normalized RGB numpy array
download_and_cache_url_file: download a file from a URL and cache it locally for reuse
layout_image_batch_for_display: layout a batch of images into a stitched grid with white separators
show_stitched_torch_image_batch: display a stitched batch of torch tensor images with optional max display limit
save_and_display_image_batch: save and optionally display a batch of images with stitching and config support
